text:
zoe: Cute report: Cleo achieved a full pancake roll at 2:03pm and refuses to un-pancake. pic: https://img.redwood.example/cleo_pancake.jpg
adan: this is illegal levels of adorable. cinnamon roll energy. :heart_eyes:
kai: is that a tiny decorative bow on her ball? i'm caving. :pleading_face:
elsa: hedgehog snore ASMR incoming. someone cue the ambient playlist. :musical_note:
brew-bot: image uploaded by zoe 14 cleo_pancake.jpg (1200x800)
zoe: she literally flattened until only whiskers remained. refuses to admit she is being dramatic. :flushed:
adan: petition to make Cleo the unofficial office mascot. i will design a tiny logo. :sparkles:
kai: who snuck her sunflower seeds? guilty party raise hands. 
elsa: that was me. 100% guilty. worth it. :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
adan: adding 'flat hedgehog' emoji to the swag list. who9s with me?
zoe: include a mini plush. i will buy one immediately. :money_with_wings:
kai: quality control question: does she do the tiny snort when exhaling or am i hallucinating? :thinking:
elsa: recorded it. will attach if people want. it's monetarily valuable calm content. :relieved:
brew-bot: file uploaded: cleo_snort.mp3 (12s)
adan: played it. instant calm. marking as official morale booster for Q2. :white_check_mark:
zoe: thanks for indulging my hedgehog content. more if people want. :heart:
